shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit dist-tags time.modified 2>&1 | head -20; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -15

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && for f in types ThemeProvider ThemeContext ThemeSettingsContext useTheme useThemeValue useThemeType useSystemTheme useThemeContext constants; do echo "=== $f.d.ts"; cat $f.d.ts; done; echo "=== ThemeProvider.js"; cat ThemeProvider.js

mkdir -p /tmp/uikit8 && cd /tmp/uikit8 && npm pack @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --silent 2>&1 | tail -1 && tar xzf gravity-ui-uikit-8.0.0.tgz && cd package && echo "=== peerDeps" && node -e 'const p=require("./package.json");console.log(JSON.stringify({peer:p.peerDependencies,deps:p.dependencies,exports:Object.keys(p.exports)},null,1))' && echo "=== theme dir" && ls build/esm/components/theme/ && echo "=== CHANGELOG 8.0.0" && awk '/^## \[8\.0\.0\]/{p=1} p&&/^## \[7\./{exit} p' CHANGELOG.md | head -150

cd /tmp/uikit8/package && ls && echo "=== styles" && ls styles | head -30 && cd build/esm/components/theme && for f in index types Provider ThemeProvider ThemeContext useTheme useThemeValue useThemeType useThemeContext useSystemTheme constants; do echo "=== $f.d.ts"; cat $f.d.ts; done; echo "=== Provider.js"; cat Provider.js; echo "=== ThemeProvider.js"; cat ThemeProvider.js

cd /tmp/uikit8/package/build/esm && echo "=== root index theme exports" && grep -n -i "theme\|Provider" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Switch.d.ts"; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== Button.d.ts"; cat components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== Icon.d.ts"; cat components/Icon/Icon.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup"; ls components/SegmentedRadioGroup 2>/dev/null; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== gravity icons moon/sun"; ls /tmp/uikit8/package/node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; npm view @gravity-ui/icons version 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/uikit8/package && echo "=== README provider mentions" && grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "Provider" README.md | head -80; echo "=== docs listing"; curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/gravity-ui/uikit/contents/docs | grep '"path"'; curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/gravity-ui/uikit/contents/docs/migration 2>/dev/null | grep '"path"'

cd /tmp/uikit8/package/build/esm/components && echo "=== ControlProps/ControlGroupProps" && grep -n -A12 "interface ControlProps\|interface ControlGroupProps\|interface ControlGroupOption" types.d.ts; echo "=== Button types"; sed -n 1,80p Button/types.d.ts; echo "=== icons installed"; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E "^(Sun|Moon|Display|Monitor|Gear)"
cd /tmp/uikit8/package && sed -n '/Documentation for AI agents/,$p' README.md | head -60
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit@^8.0.0 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 2>&1 | tail -8 && grep -A3 '"dependencies"' package.json && node -e 'console.log(require("@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json").version)'

cd /tmp/uikit8/package/build/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -60; echo "=== theme-related docs"; grep -ril "useTheme\|switch.*theme\|theme.*switch" . | head; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup doc"; find . -iname "*segmented*" | head -3; f=$(find . -iname "*SegmentedRadioGroup*" | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && sed -n 1,120p "$f"
cd /tmp/uikit8 && sed -n 200,420p theming.md

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && echo "=== SRG index" && cat SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts && echo "=== Icon index" && cat Icon/index.d.ts && echo "=== Flex" && sed -n 1,80p layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts && echo "=== Text props" && grep -n "export interface TextProps" -A20 Text/Text.d.ts && echo "=== Card" && grep -n "CardView\|CardTheme\|CardType\|CardSize\|export interface CardProps" -A6 Card/Card.d.ts | head -60 && echo "=== layout index" && cat layout/index.d.ts | head -30

echo "=== layout types" && grep -n "gap\|Space\b\|type Space\|SpaceToken\|spacing" layout/types.d.ts | head -30 && echo "=== Box props" && grep -n "interface BoxProps" -A30 layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -50 && echo "=== Text variants" && grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|TextVariant\b" -A8 Text/text/text.d.ts | head -30 && grep -rn "header-1\|body-1" Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5 && grep -n "color?" -A2 Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/gap={1}/gap="spacing-1"/' src/theme/ThemeSwitcher.tsx && grep -n 'gap=' src/theme/ThemeSwitcher.tsx && sed -n 100,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer" ; echo "browser-check-done"
git status --short && echo "=== lock uikit" && grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit"' -A2 package-lock.json | head -4
rm -rf dist && git status --short
sed -e "s#/home/sandbox/workspace/src/#./#g" /tmp/smoke/smoke.tsx > src/__smoke__.tsx && npx vite-node src/__smoke__.tsx 2>&1 | tail -12; rm -f src/__smoke__.tsx; git status --short
